from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """Asset data for one company extracted from its financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities/trading code if available")
    non_current_assets_amount: float | None = Field(description="Amount of non-current assets in yuan")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The financial reporting period, e.g. 2024年第一季度")
    report_date: str | None = Field(description="The reporting date, e.g. 2024年3月31日")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_asset_records: list[CompanyAssetRecord]
